## Golden Gates — BABSCon

**Who she is.** Golden Gates (“Goldie”) is the kind, patient lead mascot of **Bay Area Brony Spectacular (BABSCon)**, and a heroine in its original *Legends of BABSCon* convention storyline. She leads her siblings **Silver Span** (brother) and **Copper Chip** (sister) in protecting the fictional San Franciscolt from Queen Quake. This is **official BABSCon-created continuity**, not an established appearance in Hasbro’s *Friendship is Magic* television episodes. [BABSCon’s 2025 character description](https://www.babscon.com/2025/get-involved/casting-call/).

**How to recognize her.** A pale golden/cream **pegasus** with large blue eyes, freckles, and a vivid **cyan, orange, and hot-pink mane and tail**; her cutie mark features a yellow **lemon**. Her established name, *Golden Gates*, was in use by 2014 and evokes San Francisco’s Golden Gate Bridge. “**Goldie**” is an affectionate nickname used in convention scripts, not a separate identity.

**Where she appears and speaks.** Convention logos, promotions, plushes, live opening/closing theatrics, and BABSCon’s own multi-year lore; she also featured in a [2014 *Legends of Equestria* promotional crossover](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2014/03/legends-of-equestria-at-babscon.html). She **has dialogue**: BABSCon recruited performers for stage appearances and pre-recorded voice work, but a definitive, consistent voice-actor credit was **not verified**. The [2024 casting script](https://www.babscon.com/2024/get-involved/casting-call/) calls her “Goldie” and describes **Poniko**, Japan PonyCon’s mascot, as her girlfriend within that convention’s storyline. BABSCon credits **Chocopony** with assisting her later visual design, rather than sole creation of her original character ([2024 guest biography](https://www.babscon.com/2024/people-to-see/community-guests/)).

## Important moments

These are **BABSCon convention-story arcs**, **not *Friendship is Magic* TV episodes** (so no TV season/episode numbers). Verified full-episode scene timestamps were unavailable.

1. **Protecting the Emperor’s Staff — BABSCon lore, 2016.** Golden Gates and her siblings guard the magical Staff against Queen Quake and carry the struggle into the convention world ([official *Legends of BABSCon* narrative](https://www.babscon.com/2025/who-are-we/legends-of-babscon/); timestamp unavailable).
2. **Gaining Andreas as an ally — BABSCon, 2016.** Inspired by the attendees’ friendship, former henchpony Andreas changes sides and joins Golden Gates against Queen Quake (same official narrative; timestamp unavailable).
3. **Leading the resistance — BABSCon, 2017.** She returns to endangered San Franciscolt with her siblings and Andreas, and helps prevent Queen Quake from seizing the Staff (same official narrative; timestamp unavailable).
4. **Lost in space — BABSCon’s later storyline, 2023–24.** Golden Gates and her siblings are accidentally launched into space, prompting a mission to find and bring them home ([BABSCon theatrics briefing](https://www.babscon.com/2024/get-involved/volunteer/); timestamp unavailable).
